sloka: रामवाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हरयो जितकाशिनः ।पादपैरर्दयन् वीरा वानराः परवाहिनीम् ।। ६.६१.३९ ॥
transliteration: rāmavākyamupaśrutya harayo jitakāśinaḥ ।pādapairardayan vīrā vānarāḥ paravāhinīm ।। 6.61.39 ॥

translations.english: The monkeys desiring to be triumphant, took trees and began to strike at the enemies on hearing Rama's control.
